title: Unhandled Null Pointer Exception on Non-Existent User ID Lookup
symptom: Querying GET /users/99999 caused an unhandled ValueError/RuntimeError in the user service, crashing the server process with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of returning 404.
root_cause: The repository query failed to catch missing record exceptions before dereferencing user attributes.
regression_test_requirement: Test suites targeting GET /users/{user_id} must query non-existent IDs and assert HTTP 404 Not Found with error detail message.
